angle: The truth about smart speakers you don't need
hook: Stop wasting money on smart speakers — here's why.
script: Stop wasting money on smart speakers — here's why. They promise seamless control of your home, but honestly, you’ll end up using your phone instead. The voice recognition can be hit or miss, and many features are just frustratingly slow. Most functions can be done with existing devices you already own. In our testing, the novelty wears off fast. Save your cash for tech that truly enhances your life. Follow for more.
caption_body: Think you need a smart speaker? Think again! 💸
